name: Nutrition
overview: Scripture reveals that God provided humanity with a variety of foods for sustenance, beginning with plants bearing seed and fruit as given in Genesis 1:29, and extending to all living creatures after the Flood (Genesis 9:3). The dietary instructions in Leviticus emphasize holiness and obedience, forbidding certain fats and prescribing careful discernment in what is eaten. Ultimately, Deuteronomy 8:3 reminds believers that physical nourishment is not sufficient for life; true life is sustained by every word from the mouth of the LORD, underscoring the priority of spiritual nourishment over mere physical diet. Proverbs 23:20 warns against excess and indulgence, encouraging self-control in eating and drinking.
